o.text: Literally, “to hold in view”. Possibly a calque of Russian име́ть в виду́ (imétʹ v vidú).
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish كستانه (kestane), ultimately from Ancient Greek κάστανα (kástana).
Blend of telekanal (“TV channel”) + kanalizasiya (“sewerage, drainage; canalization”). Also can be analyzed as tele- (“tele-”) + kanalizasiya. Compare Russian телеканализация (telekanalizacija).
